item.description:
### Added - **Approve or deny Devin's requests from your iPhone, Apple Watch or Mac.** When Devin asks permission to run a command, Perch shows the request the way it does for Claude Code and Codex, and your answer goes back to Devin. If you don't answer in time, Devin shows its own dialog as before. While approvals are on, Devin waits up to 45 seconds for your answer before it shows that dialog. - **Reply to and stop Codex sessions from your iPhone, in Codex's default mode.** Since Codex 0.157 a session runs in Codex's background service, and until now those rows said replies and Stop weren't available. Perch now reaches the session through that service. Stop also works while Codex is writing its answer, which pressing Escape didn't.
### Improved - **Storage finds more of your projects.** Worktrees and build folders now show for projects you worked on with Cursor, Devin, Droid, Muse or Antigravity, not only Claude Code and Codex.
### Fixed - **Cursor: stopping a turn no longer says it finished.** A turn you cancel with Ctrl+C now reads "Interrupted", with no finished alert. - **Cursor: live status works if you've moved Cursor's config folder.** With `CURSOR_CONFIG_DIR` set, Perch's hooks were installed where Cursor never read them. Perch also finds Cursor's chats under `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`.
